notes: Characters no longer show up twice. The game update of 21 November sometimes gives no realm name at login, so each character got a second record and the gold of both was counted. The program joins them back into one (the newer data wins), and the addon no longer makes such records.
Home: every character card starts folded - who it is, gold, goods, how much is to do and the next step. “Show more” opens one, and the page remembers it.
Undead characters are called Undead, not by the game's inner name.
